name: frostsworn-paladin-enter-banish-floating-draw-buff
notes: Frostsworn Paladin (rpOaAjgtue, WATER ALLY, reserve 3): "Intercept. On Enter: You may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card and put a buff counter on Frostsworn Paladin." The champion is patched to Mordred, Flawless Blade (level 2; its static ability gives attack cards in the graveyard floating memory) and a Striking Tides (an attack card) is seeded in the graveyard. The Paladin is played from hand for real (3 reserve payments), so enterAbilities["rpOaAjgtue:0"] fires: the graveyard attack card is offered, banished, a card is drawn and the Paladin gets exactly one buff counter.

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard.
If you do, draw a card and put a buff counter on Frostsworn Paladin.
